Moral Hazard and the Return of Lost Species

R. Okonkwo-Hale and T. Lindqvist

https://doi.org/10.5555/jscs.2026.0012

Abstract

De-extinction promises to undo the loss of species, but a promise of repair can weaken the incentive to prevent the loss in the first place. We set out how that moral hazard arises in conservation funding, and what a program would have to show to avoid it.
